title: Device status
description: How each of the hub's devices is doing, by the device's ID. Held by the hub itself, so a screen can show a light for a device and a rule can react when one drops.

values.title: Connected
values.description: True while the device's driver is running and can reach the device.

values.title: Status
values.description: One word: connected, degraded, unreachable, starting, down, stopped or quarantined.
